lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hey, Commander!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: How are you feeling today?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Seems like you've been pulling quite a few all-nighters lately.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm just making sure you're not stretching yourself too thin.
Everything is fine.
I'm just a little tired, to be honest.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I know you're just saying that, so I don't worry about you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But you don't have to do that for me.
I'm just a little tired, to be honest.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can only imagine!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm sure resting your head in my lap

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: will do you a world of good.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What do you say?
Sorry, but I feel like I'm being pulled in so many directions.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I haven't heard anything negative

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: about your performance lately.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So what's got you in such a tizzy?
I'm worried that I won't be able to perform my job properly.
There are so many things I haven't accomplished yet.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You're the center of attention right now,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so it's completely understandable if the pressure got to you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You always want to do so much for us.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can see why you'd feel anxious about reaching your goal.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: How about this?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Think about the big picture!
What do you mean?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Before I tell you,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: let me ask you something.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: How has the last year been?
It was eventful.
It was all a blur.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You've always been running around like a headless chicken

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: ever since you were commissioned.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What's more, one of your comrades was injured.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You must have been through things too painful to recollect

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: but I'm sure there must be lots of happy memories as well!
You're right.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Precisely!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: All of that made up your year, both the good and the bad.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Think about it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you take it easy for just one day

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and just kick back for once,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: it won't affect what you've achieved over the course of a year.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you look at the bigger picture, it won't make a difference at all!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: On the other hand, if you run yourself ragged,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: you may end up doing irreparable damage to your mind and body.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I only wish to take care of you

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: like the way you've taken care of us.
All right, I'll take better care of myself.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Brilliant, hehe!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll drop by your room later to make sure

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: you're not burning the midnight oil again!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If I catch you working overtime, you'll be in big trouble!  >:(
Thank you for always taking care of me.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's nothing! Hehe.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You're always so good to us,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so I'm just returning the favor.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Have a good day! ^___^
